title: Classify Deployment Models
prompt: For each situation, select the architecture model that best fits: Public cloud, Private cloud, Hybrid, On-premises, or Air-gapped/OT.

items.label: Customer configures identities and data with a provider; infrastructure remains with the provider
Datacenter dedicated to a single organization, with patching and power managed internally
Cloud application connected to an on-premises database via VPN and federated identity
Servers, storage, and backups owned and administered entirely on-site
SCADA production line with no Internet connection; transfers via controlled media
Lab network physically separated from the corporate office network
On-demand workload running at a provider with no OS to maintain
Infrastructure shared among multiple hospitals within the same group
Sensitive data kept on-site, analytics hosted in the cloud
Equipment and network cabling entirely dedicated to a critical environment
Recovery and patching entirely handled by the organization, with no infrastructure provider
Services distributed across two providers to reduce single-vendor lock-in

explain: Reason based on infrastructure ownership, control responsibility, and isolation level. Serverless and multicloud remain variants of public cloud; the junction point of a hybrid model is a distinct trust zone.
